description: The plot illustrates the loss comparison between vanilla Transformer and SepLLM with respect to training time. The x-axis is labeled "Training Time (s)" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 25000 seconds, and tick labels at intervals of 5000 seconds. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" with a linear scale, ranging from 2.25 to 2.75, and tick labels at intervals of 0.05. Two lines are shown: a blue dashed line representing "Vanilla" and a red solid line representing "SepLLM". The blue dashed line starts at approximately 2.68 at 0 seconds and decreases to around 2.59 at 25000 seconds. The red solid line begins at about 2.62 at 0 seconds and declines to roughly 2.53 at 25000 seconds. Both lines exhibit a downward trend, with the red solid line consistently below the blue dashed line throughout the range.
